verdict.rationale: PostHog's CDP is described as pulling in data and 'sending the result wherever it needs to go, in realtime or on a schedule' and workflows can 'send messages to your users,' which implies outbound webhook-style destinations exist, but no evidence explicitly names webhooks or a subscribe-to-events API for AI agents. missing for 10: explicit webhook destination documentation, webhook payload/event schema, and confirmation this can be consumed programmatically by an AI agent.
